remove-duplicate-lines.name: Remove Duplicate Lines
remove-duplicate-lines.description: Remove duplicate lines from your text while preserving order.
remove-duplicate-lines.howTo: Paste your text into the editor and click the transform button. All duplicate lines will be removed, keeping only the first occurrence of each line.
remove-duplicate-lines.faq1a: Yes, the first occurrence of each line is kept in its original position.
remove-duplicate-lines.faq2a: Lines are compared exactly, including whitespace. Two lines with different spacing are considered different.

remove-empty-lines.name: Remove Empty Lines
remove-empty-lines.description: Delete all blank lines from your text instantly.
remove-empty-lines.howTo: Paste your text and click the button. All empty or whitespace-only lines will be removed, keeping your content compact.
remove-empty-lines.faq1q: Does it remove lines with spaces?
remove-empty-lines.faq1a: Yes, lines containing only whitespace characters (spaces, tabs) are also removed.
remove-empty-lines.faq2a: No, but you can use Undo (Ctrl+Z) in the text area immediately after the transformation.

remove-line-breaks.name: Remove Line Breaks
remove-line-breaks.description: Join all lines into a single line by removing line breaks.
remove-line-breaks.howTo: Paste multi-line text and click the button. All line breaks will be replaced with spaces, creating a single paragraph.
remove-line-breaks.faq1a: The tool collapses multiple spaces into one, so words won't merge together unintentionally.
remove-line-breaks.faq2a: Use Ctrl+Z immediately after the transformation, or keep a backup of your original text.

trim-text.name: Trim Text
trim-text.description: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from your text.
trim-text.howTo: Paste your text and click Trim. Any spaces, tabs, or newlines at the very beginning or end of your text will be removed.
trim-text.faq1q: Does it affect text in the middle?
trim-text.faq1a: No, only whitespace at the start and end of the entire text is removed.
trim-text.faq2a: Only leading and trailing whitespace is removed. Internal spacing remains unchanged.

sort-lines.name: Sort Lines
sort-lines.description: Sort lines alphabetically in ascending order.
sort-lines.howTo: Paste your list of lines and click Sort. The lines will be reordered alphabetically using natural locale-aware comparison.
sort-lines.faq1a: The sort uses locale-aware comparison, which typically places uppercase before lowercase. Results may vary by language.
sort-lines.faq2q: Can I sort in descending order?
sort-lines.faq2a: Currently only ascending alphabetical order is supported.

regex-tester.name: Regex Tester
regex-tester.description: Test regular expressions in real-time against your text.
regex-tester.howTo: Enter your text in the input area, type your regex pattern, and select flags. Matches will be highlighted in real-time. All processing is done locally for safety.
regex-tester.faq1q: Is this safe? Can regex crash my browser?
regex-tester.faq1a: The tool uses JavaScript's built-in RegExp engine and processes everything locally. While catastrophic backtracking is possible with complex patterns, all computation is sandboxed in your browser.
regex-tester.faq2a: Common flags like g (global), i (case-insensitive), m (multiline), s (dotall), and u (unicode) are supported.

html-formatter.name: HTML Formatter
html-formatter.description: Format and beautify messy HTML code.
html-formatter.howTo: Paste your HTML code into the editor and click the Format button. The tool will add proper indentation and line breaks for readability.
html-formatter.faq1a:
Yes, the formatter recognizes self-closing tags like
, , and .
html-formatter.faq2a: The formatter works best with well-formed HTML. Severely broken HTML may not format as expected.

css-formatter.name: CSS Formatter
css-formatter.howTo: Paste your CSS code and click Format. The tool will organize selectors, properties, and values with consistent indentation.
css-formatter.faq1a: Properties within each rule are formatted but not reordered alphabetically.
css-formatter.faq2a: Currently only standard CSS is supported. SASS/SCSS preprocessor syntax may not format correctly.

javascript-formatter.name: JavaScript Formatter
javascript-formatter.howTo: Paste your JavaScript code and click Format. The tool will add consistent indentation and line breaks.
javascript-formatter.faq1q: Is this as powerful as Prettier?
javascript-formatter.faq1a: This is a lightweight formatter focused on basic indentation. For advanced formatting, dedicated tools like Prettier are recommended.
javascript-formatter.faq2a: The formatter handles basic JavaScript syntax. Very complex or minified code may need a more powerful tool.

yaml-formatter.name: YAML Formatter
yaml-formatter.description: Format and clean up YAML configuration files.
yaml-formatter.howTo: Paste your YAML content and click Format. Extra blank lines will be cleaned up and indentation will be normalized.
yaml-formatter.faq1a: This tool focuses on formatting. Basic indentation issues may be corrected, but full YAML validation is not performed.
yaml-formatter.faq2q: Will it change my YAML structure?
yaml-formatter.faq2a: No, the formatting only affects whitespace and blank lines. The data structure remains unchanged.

markdown-formatter.name: Markdown Formatter
markdown-formatter.howTo: Paste your Markdown content and click Format. The tool will normalize spacing, fix heading formatting, and clean up lists.
markdown-formatter.faq1q: Does it support all Markdown syntax?
markdown-formatter.faq1a: Common Markdown elements like headings, lists, code blocks, and paragraphs are supported.
markdown-formatter.faq2a: No, content inside code blocks (triple backticks) is preserved exactly as written.

uuid-generator.name: UUID Generator
uuid-generator.howTo: Click the Generate button to create a new UUID v4 identifier. You can generate multiple UUIDs and copy them individually.
uuid-generator.faq1a: This tool generates UUID v4 (random) using the browser's crypto API.
uuid-generator.faq2a: The UUIDs are generated using cryptographically strong random values via the Web Crypto API.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Create strong, secure passwords with custom options.
password-generator.howTo: Select your desired options (length, include numbers, symbols, uppercase/lowercase letters) and click Generate. Copy the password with one click.
password-generator.faq1a: Passwords are generated using cryptographically secure random values from the Web Crypto API.
password-generator.faq2a: No, passwords are generated entirely in your browser and never leave your device. They are not stored or transmitted.

lorem-ipsum-generator.name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
lorem-ipsum-generator.description: Generate placeholder text for your designs and layouts.
lorem-ipsum-generator.howTo: Click Generate to create Lorem Ipsum placeholder text. The tool generates multiple paragraphs of classic filler text.
lorem-ipsum-generator.faq1a: Each click generates approximately 3 paragraphs of Lorem Ipsum text.
lorem-ipsum-generator.faq2a: Currently the tool generates a fixed amount of text. Copy what you need and regenerate for more.

utm-generator.name: UTM Generator
utm-generator.description: Build UTM-tracked URLs for your marketing campaigns.
utm-generator.howTo: Fill in the required fields: Website URL, campaign source, medium, and campaign name. Optionally add campaign term and content. Click Generate to get your tracked URL.
utm-generator.faq1a: UTM parameters are tags added to URLs that help analytics tools track where your traffic comes from and how users find your content.
utm-generator.faq2q: Can I reuse the generated URLs?
utm-generator.faq2a: Yes, generated URLs are permanent as long as the base URL is valid. You can save and reuse them.

uppercase-guide.title: How to Convert Text to Uppercase Online
uppercase-guide.excerpt: Learn how to quickly convert any text to uppercase using free online tools. A step-by-step guide for writers, developers, and content creators.
uppercase-guide.body:
Converting text to uppercase is one of the most common text formatting needs. Whether you're fixing a title, standardizing data, or just want your text to stand out, an online text to uppercase converter is the fastest solution.

With ConvertTextEasy, you can convert any text to uppercase instantly and for free. Simply type or paste your text into the editor, click "Uppercase", and the conversion happens immediately in your browser.

This approach is not only fast but also private. Since all processing happens locally on your device, your text never leaves your computer. There are no servers involved, no data storage, and no privacy concerns.

Additionally, you can copy the result with one click, clear the editor to start fresh, or download the converted text as a file. It's the simplest way to get perfectly formatted uppercase text every time.

remove-spaces-guide.title: How to Remove Extra Spaces from Text
remove-spaces-guide.excerpt: Messy whitespace can ruin formatting. Discover how to clean up extra spaces, tabs, and line breaks from your text instantly.
remove-spaces-guide.body:
Extra spaces in text can be a real headache. Whether you're copying from a PDF, dealing with inconsistent formatting, or cleaning up user input, double spaces, trailing whitespace, and irregular indentation can ruin your content.

ConvertTextEasy's "Remove Extra Spaces" tool solves this problem instantly. It trims leading and trailing whitespace, collapses multiple spaces into one, and ensures your text is clean and consistent.

This tool is particularly useful for cleaning up text copied from emails, documents, or web pages. Instead of manually fixing each spacing issue, you can process your entire text in one click.

Like all ConvertTextEasy tools, the space removal runs entirely in your browser. Your data remains private and secure, with no uploads to any server.

free-text-tools.title: Free Tools to Format Text Online
free-text-tools.excerpt: A curated list of free browser-based tools for text formatting, conversion, and cleanup — no sign-up required, completely private.
free-text-tools.body:
There are many text formatting tools available online, but not all of them respect your privacy. Many services require you to upload your text to their servers, which means your data is no longer under your control.

Every tool on ConvertTextEasy runs locally in your browser. This means your text never leaves your device. We don't store, log, or transmit any of your content.

Our growing collection includes tools for case conversion, text cleaning, Unicode styling, and developer formats. All tools are completely free to use with no limits or registration required.

The philosophy is simple: text tools should be free, fast, and private. ConvertTextEasy delivers on all three promises, giving you professional-grade text conversion without compromising your privacy.
